title: Package
description: The sellable unit. No inventory/availability fields by design — prices[] carries commercial (store/channel) context so Product itself can stay scope-neutral.

gtin.description: GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) for the sellable Package. When present must use scheme "gtin". Nullable. Package.gtin does not carry lot/batch. One of three lot/batch shapes in core: LabResult.batch_lot (string), Label.identity_compliance.lot (Identifier), Package.gtin (GTIN only). Lot vs Batch terminology intentionally left open. Schema.org 'gtin' and GS1 expectations are inspiration for the field shape and semantics, not conformance requirements.

gram_equivalency.description: Flower-equivalent grams, for purchase-limit math. Always grams by definition, so unlike other measurements it is a bare number rather than a Quantity.

extensions.description: Free-form namespace for profile-specific additions. Profiles restrict core, never extend it outside this map.
